statement: The target-wise protocol identifies whether pair-level resources form screening-scale candidate pools.
Strong ligand-only controls can saturate ROBIN molecule-perturbation early retrieval.
ROBIN network perturbation exposes target-context label-transfer failure despite near-identical chemistry.
RNAsmol gains concentrate in low-label-agreement network pools under the audited ROBIN settings.
The manuscript does not introduce a new RNA-compound architecture.
The manuscript does not prove causal RNA-binding mechanisms from label-transfer associations.
The manuscript does not claim low-cost screening replaces docking, pose prediction, or complex modeling.
The manuscript does not claim RNAsmol is universally superior across all RNA-compound datasets.
